definitions.explanation: The measurement of something from end to end; the extent of something along its greatest dimension.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{紐|ひも}→紐：02251_himo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{長|なが}さ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧2⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The length of this string is 2 meters.
To measure the length of hair.

examples.japanese: {長|なが}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧。

notes:
{長|なが}さ is derived from the adjective ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧ (long) + the suffix 〜さ, which turns adjectives into nouns expressing degree or measurement.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {長|なが}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧: to measure the length
- {長|なが}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧: the length is not enough
- {長|なが}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調整|ちょうせい}する→調整：14839_chousei⟧: to adjust the length

SIMILAR MEASUREMENT NOUNS (adjective + さ):
- ⟦{高|たか}さ→高さ：05327_takasa⟧: height (from ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧)
- ⟦{深|ふか}さ→深さ：05328_fukasa⟧: depth (from ⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧)
- ⟦{広|ひろ}さ→広さ：00105_hirosa⟧: area, spaciousness (from ⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧)
- ⟦{厚|あつ}さ→厚さ：05329_atsusa⟧: thickness (from ⟦{厚|あつ}い→厚い：00690_atsui⟧)
- ⟦{重|おも}さ→重さ：14444_omosa⟧: weight (from ⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧)

USAGE:
{長|なが}さ refers to spatial length, time duration, or abstract extent (e.g., ⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{長|なが}さ = the length of a text).
